description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquisition the Lands of Thumbathenna watta, Mahagalagawahena & Atlantawatta, Imbulpe D/S Division, Pathnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple notices about specific land parcels being acquired by the state, including detailed descriptions of land names, plot numbers, extents, and compensation amounts deposited in court. The content focuses solely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
